name: What factors should I consider when choosing a plumber for my bathroom installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a plumber for my bathroom installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a plumber for bathroom installation, consider their experience with similar projects, their licensing and insurance, and their reputation. Look for plumbers who provide clear, detailed estimates and have good communication. Checking references or online reviews can also provide insight into their reliability and quality of work. Local knowledge of East Bay building codes is also a plus.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider experience, licensing, insurance, reputation, clear estimates, and local code knowledge when choosing a plumber.
